layout.mockNotice: MOCK mode. This screen shows fake data and is read-only, so saving is rejected.
layout.openMonitorHint: Race day: status · laps · ranking · finals

common.enFallback: Leave empty to show the Korean value on the English site.
common.koRequired: Enter the Korean value. It is the default text on the public site.
common.staleNotice: Someone else changed this item in the meantime. Saving now will be rejected, so load the latest values and edit again.

connection.closed: Disconnected. Changes made by others may show up late.

error.network: Could not reach the server. Check the network connection and try again.
error.mockReadonly: Saving is disabled in MOCK mode. Try again on a screen connected to the real server.
error.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Log in again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this. Ask an admin.
error.notFound: This item no longer exists. Someone may have deleted it; check the list.
error.versionConflict: Someone else saved first. The latest values have been loaded; review them and save again.
error.duplicate: That value already exists. Enter a different one.
error.downstreamFinished: A later match that received this result is already finished. Reopen that match first.
error.matchFinished: This match is already finished. Reopen its result before changing it.
error.bracketStarted: The finals have started, so the seeds cannot be filled again. Leave a withdrawn team's slot empty and its opponent advances by walkover (rule 5.1.3). To change a slot, edit it in the admin finals bracket.
error.matchNotFinished: This match is not finished yet. Check the bracket again.
error.bracketExists: A bracket already exists. Delete all rounds before generating a new one.
error.lastAdmin: The last admin account cannot be deactivated or made a referee. Create another admin first.
error.rateLimited: Too many login attempts. Wait about 10 minutes and try again.
error.invalidCredentials: Username or password is incorrect. Check the letter case and try again.
error.validation: Some values are invalid. Check the highlighted fields.
error.server: The server ran into an error. Try again shortly, and tell the operator if it keeps happening.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again shortly.
error.unknownCode: The request failed ({{status}} {{code}}). Try again shortly.
error.monitorKeyInvalid: The monitoring link has changed. Open the new link again.
error.teamLimit: At most 15 teams can compete. Deactivate another team and try again.
error.groupFull: That group is already full. Choose another group.
error.mappingFrozen: The mapping order is frozen as the qualifying order and can no longer be changed.
error.bracketFrozen: The finals results are frozen, so the bracket and results can no longer be changed.
error.inspectionOrderTaken: The same inspection number was given to more than one team. Fix the numbers and save again.

login.title: Staff login
login.lead: Log in with a referee or admin account. Accounts are created by an admin.

noPermission.title: No permission
noPermission.body: Only admins can use this screen. Ask an admin if you need access.

notFound.title: Screen not found
notFound.body: Check the address or pick a screen from the menu above.

dashboard.title: Dashboard

monitor.title: Monitoring control
monitor.lead: Everything entered on race day happens in monitoring control. Open it while signed in with this account; the numbers below open that tab directly.
monitor.keyNone: None yet. Only signed-in staff can open it.

dashboard.teamsHint: Competing (active) teams shown on the public site. Every team has an ID, and qualifying laps, ranking and bracket all link to it.
dashboard.bracketEmpty: No bracket yet. Create one in Edit bracket.

live.title: Live status
live.lead: Shown immediately at the top of the public live page.
live.noticeHint: Leave empty to remove the notice. Up to 500 characters.

qualifying.title: Qualifying laps
qualifying.lead: The team on track is selected automatically. Press 'Valid lap' or 'Invalid lap' after every lap. Saved laps appear on the public leaderboard right away.
qualifying.search: Find by team name or ID
qualifying.searchHint: Part of the name is enough. Numbers search by team ID.
qualifying.noTeams: There are no active teams. An admin must register teams first.
qualifying.noSearchMatch: No team matches '{{query}}'. Check the team name.
qualifying.lapHint: Valid Q3 laps need a lap time: the two timekeepers' average to two decimal places, as seconds (42.14) or min:sec (1:02.35).
qualifying.lapRequired: Enter the lap time for a valid Q3 lap, or press 'Invalid lap'.
qualifying.lapFormat: Wrong format. Enter it to two decimal places, like 42.14 or 1:02.35.
qualifying.lapRange: Lap times must be between 1.00 seconds and 10:00.00.
qualifying.recentFilterHint: Pick a team to fix or cancel an older lap. Shows all of that team's laps.
qualifying.recentTeamEmpty: No laps for this team yet.
qualifying.recentEmpty: No laps yet. Enter the first one above.
qualifying.voidBody: Attempt {{attempt}} of {{team}} ({{time}}) will no longer count. The record stays with the reason.
qualifying.voidReasonHint: Required. For example: entered for the wrong team, pressed twice
qualifying.voidConflict: Someone else changed this lap in the meantime. The latest values are loaded; check them and press again.
qualifying.missionHint: After 3 valid laps in a row the next mission starts automatically. Do not record transition laps between missions.
qualifying.lapOptional: Optional for Q1 and Q2. If entered, it is kept with the lap.

judgement.title: Rulings
judgement.faLostHint: Press if a person intervened (hand, joystick, keyboard, computer) or the car stopped for more than 5 seconds.
judgement.faAchieved: Q1–Q3 are passed, so FA is achieved for now. Press if there was an intervention or a stop over 5 seconds.
judgement.rankDropHint: For violations under section 8, the final qualifying position drops one place each time.

dialogBody.fa_lost: This team will not get FA even if it passes Q1–Q3. If this was a mistake, cancel the ruling.
dialogBody.rank_drop: The team moves one place below its calculated position. Each drop moves it one more place.

fa_lost.intervention: A person intervened (hand, joystick, keyboard, computer)

rank_drop.route: A person corrected the route or chose it by obstacle positions
rank_drop.control: Joystick, keyboard or mouse used while driving
rank_drop.track: Did not restore a track moved by a collision

inspection.title: Inspection order
inspection.description: Type the order in which each team finished inspection, then save. It appears next to the team on the public qualifying leaderboard, and when results are tied the lower number ranks higher (rule 4.7). Leave blank to clear.
inspection.saved: Inspection order saved. It is shown on the public leaderboard right away.
inspection.bad: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
inspection.taken: Number {{numbers}} is given to more than one team.

bracket.title: Bracket
bracket.leadAdmin: Edit rounds, matches and slots, and enter results. Saving a result fills the next match's slots automatically.
bracket.leadReferee: For each match, enter every slot's rank and note, then finish it. Next match slots fill automatically.
bracket.frozen: The finals results are frozen. Results can no longer be entered or undone, and the bracket can no longer be edited.
bracket.seedTitle: Fill the seeds from the ranking?
bracket.seedBody: Puts the team ranked N into each 'Qualifying #N' slot. Teams already placed may change. Once any finals match is finished, the seeds cannot be filled again.
bracket.seeded: Filled the seeds from the ranking.
bracket.roundAdded: Round added. Now use 'Add match' to create matches.
bracket.deleteRoundBody_one: Its {{count}} match and result are deleted for good. Slots that received results from it lose that link.
bracket.deleteRoundBody_other: Its {{count}} matches and their results are deleted for good. Slots that received results from them lose that link.
bracket.roundEmpty: This round has no matches yet.
bracket.roundEmptyAdmin: This round has no matches yet. Use 'Add match'.
bracket.matchAdded: Match {{label}} added. Use 'Edit slots' to set teams or sources.
bracket.label: Match label
bracket.labelHint: A short name unique in the bracket, e.g. M1
bracket.labelDuplicate: A match with that label already exists. Use another label.
bracket.statusHint: A match is finished only by entering its result.
bracket.finishedLocked: This match is finished. Reopen its result to change this.
bracket.deleteMatchBody: The match and its result are deleted for good.
bracket.deleteMatchAffects: Slots in {{labels}} that received its result lose that link.
bracket.teamsMissing: This match has no team yet. Open it again once seeds or previous results fill it.
bracket.teamsMissingShort: Results can be entered once a team is in.
bracket.rankMissing: Choose a result for every slot with a team.
bracket.finishBody: Finishing fills the next match slots right away and updates the public bracket.
bracket.finishedNotice: {{label}} finished. Next match slots are filled.
bracket.reopenBody: Ranks and notes are cleared and the match goes back to scheduled. Next match slots that got teams from it are cleared too.
bracket.downstreamFinished: {{labels}} is already finished, so this cannot be reopened. Reopen {{labels}} first.
bracket.emptyAdmin: There is no bracket yet. Generate a single-elimination bracket, or add rounds yourself below.
bracket.emptyReferee: There is no bracket yet. It appears here once an admin creates it.
bracket.generateHint: First-round slots are created as 'Qualifying P#'. Afterwards, press 'Seed from qualifying'.
bracket.manualBody: Add rounds, then set up matches and slots one by one.
bracket.slotTeamRequired: Choose the team for this slot.
bracket.slotSeedHint: Pressing 'Seed from ranking' puts the team with this rank in the ranking here.
bracket.slotSeedRequired: Enter a qualifying rank of 1 or more.
bracket.slotSourceRequired: Choose the earlier match this slot takes its team from.
bracket.placeholderHint: Shown on the public site until a team is set. Leave empty for automatic text such as 'Qualifying P3'.
bracket.swapHint: Drag a slot onto another slot to swap them. If dragging is awkward, press the arrow button on the left of a slot, then press 'Swap here' on the other slot. Slots in finished matches can be moved after the result is reopened.
bracket.swapPicking: Choose where to move {{slot}}. Press 'Swap here' on the other slot to see a confirmation.
bracket.swapBody: The team moves together with how its slot is filled (qualifying rank or previous match result). The public bracket updates right away.
bracket.swapConflict: The bracket changed in the meantime. The preview below now shows the latest bracket. Check it and press again.
bracket.leadSetup: Build the finals bracket from rounds and matches.
bracket.byeNotice: {{count}} empty slot(s) count as a bye. Rank only the slots with a team. Saving is refused if an empty slot can still be filled (seeds not filled yet, or the previous match isn't finished).
bracket.byeConfirm: {{count}} empty slot(s) finish without a result (bye).
help: Results and 'Seed from ranking' are done in monitoring control.
'Qualifying #N' slots take the team ranked N; slots like 'M1 #1' take that match's result.
A slot without a team counts as a bye. Use 'Edit' on each match to change its time, slot count and how slots are filled.

teams.title: Teams
teams.empty: No teams yet. Use 'Add team' to register the first one.
teams.privacy: Team names and affiliations are public. Do not enter personal data such as member names or contacts.
teams.duplicate: A team named '{{name}}' already exists. Use a different name.
teams.deactivateBody: This works like a withdrawal. The team leaves the public team list and leaderboard, and no new laps can be entered. It also leaves the ranking (teams below move up one place), any unfinished finals slots and the on-track team (press 'Fill seeds' again to refill from the updated ranking). Existing laps and finished match results stay. Reactivating does not restore the ranking or bracket slots.
teams.nameHint: The name that identifies the team. It can't match another team (case-insensitive).
teams.full: The maximum of {{max}} competing teams is reached. Deactivate another team before adding or reactivating one.
help: Teams are identified by ID and name. Names can't repeat.
Qualifying laps, ranking and the finals bracket all link to the team ID.
Teams aren't deleted: turn off the 'Competing' switch to deactivate (withdraw). The team leaves the ranking and unfinished bracket slots; turn it back on to return.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.empty: No schedule items yet. Use 'Add item' to create the first one.
schedule.endsHint: Leave empty to show only the start time.
schedule.endsAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.
schedule.deleteBody: It disappears from the public schedule right away and cannot be restored. To hide it for now, unpublish it instead.
help: Saved items appear on the public schedule after you press 'Publish' above.
Use ↑ ↓ to order items that start at the same time.
To edit everything at once, download the Markdown document at the bottom, edit it and upload it again.

doc.title: Markdown document
doc.lead: Download the whole schedule as one document, edit it and upload it again (Korean and English together).
doc.name: Schedule document
doc.format1: Under a date line like '## 2026-11-01', write each item as '### 09:00-10:00 Title'. The end time is optional.
doc.format2: Use '- 장소:', '- 영문:', '- 영문 장소:', '- 영문 설명:' lines for the place and English text; other lines are the Korean description. Add <!-- hidden --> at the end of a title line to keep it private.
doc.confirmTitle: Replace the whole schedule with this document?
doc.confirmBody: {{file}}: deletes the current {{current}} items and creates {{count}} from the document. It shows on the public site after you publish.
doc.applied: Schedule replaced ({{created}} created, {{deleted}} removed). Check it, then press 'Publish' above.
doc.notUtf8: {{file}} isn't UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and upload again.

rules.title: Rules
rules.lead: Sections appear on the public rules page in this order.
rules.empty: No rule sections yet. Use 'Add section' to create the first one.
rules.markdownHint:
Markdown: ### heading, - list, **bold**, [link](https://address), ![description](/images/picture.png). ## separates sections, so it can't be used in a body. Use
for a line break inside a table cell. Pictures come from a ZIP uploaded under 'Markdown documents' below.
rules.previewEmpty: Type the body to see it here as it will look on the public site.
rules.deleteBody: It disappears from the public rules page right away and cannot be restored. To hide it for now, unpublish it instead.

doc.title: Markdown documents
doc.lead: Download all rules as one document per language, edit it and upload it again. Use ZIP when it has images.
doc.formatHint: A '# Title' line starts a chapter (large heading) and a '## Title' line starts a section. Use '###' for headings inside a section. The first '# Rules' line is the document title and is ignored. A '<!-- hidden -->' line right under a title keeps that section private.
doc.zipHint: If the document has pictures, upload one ZIP with the Markdown document and its pictures (a Notion export ZIP works too). Relative and absolute picture paths (/images/qr.png, C:\…\qr.png) are both matched to the files in the ZIP. Pictures: png, jpg, gif, webp, avif. A ZIP can be up to {{size}} MB.
doc.confirmKo_one: The current rule section is replaced by the '## Title' sections of '{{file}}', in order. '<!-- hidden -->' marks decide visibility, and sections beyond the document's are deleted.
doc.confirmKo_other: The {{count}} current rule sections are replaced, in order, by the '## Title' sections of '{{file}}'. '<!-- hidden -->' marks decide visibility, and sections beyond the document's are deleted.
doc.confirmKoEn: English titles and bodies stay with the section in the same position. If you inserted or removed sections in between, upload the English document again too.
doc.confirmEn_one: The English title and body of the current rule section are replaced by the '## Title' sections of '{{file}}', in order. Korean content and visibility stay as they are.
doc.confirmEn_other: The English titles and bodies of the {{count}} current rule sections are replaced, in order, by the '## Title' sections of '{{file}}'. Sections the document doesn't reach lose their English text and show Korean. Korean content and visibility stay as they are.
doc.confirmZip: The document in the ZIP is applied together with the pictures it uses. Old pictures that no section uses anymore are removed from the server.
doc.confirmBackup: This cannot be undone. To keep the current content, cancel and download the 'ZIP (with pictures)' first.
doc.appliedKo: Korean document applied. New sections: {{created}}, changed: {{updated}}, deleted: {{deleted}}.
doc.appliedEn: English document applied. Sections with a changed English title or body: {{updated}}.
doc.notUtf8: '{{file}}' is not UTF-8 text. Save it again with UTF-8 encoding in your editor, then upload it.
doc.tooLarge: '{{file}}' is too large. A rules document can have up to 1,000,000 characters.
doc.zipTooLarge: '{{file}}' is too large. A ZIP can be up to {{size}} MB. Make the pictures smaller or leave out unused files, then compress again.
doc.zipTooLargeServer: The ZIP was too large for the server. Make it {{size}} MB or smaller and upload it again.
doc.notZip: '{{file}}' is not a ZIP file. Choose a Markdown document (.md) or a ZIP of the document and its pictures.
doc.readFailed: Could not read '{{file}}'. Choose the file again.
doc.serverHint: The server keeps the same documents (rules.ko.md, rules.en.md); editing sections here updates them too.

help: A chapter (# heading) groups the sections (##) below it. Indented sections in the list belong to the chapter above.
Write the body in Markdown and check it in the preview next to the editor. Use ### for headings inside a body.
Saved rules appear on the public rules page after you press 'Publish' above.
To edit everything at once, use the 'Markdown document' at the bottom.
rules.levelChapter: Chapter (# heading, groups the sections below)

settings.title: Site settings
settings.lead: Applications, page visibility and the monitoring control link.
settings.urlHint: Must start with https://, like a Naver Form link. Leave empty to show the button as 'Coming soon'.
settings.urlHttps: Enter an address that starts with https://.
settings.closeDateOnly: Closing time not set yet (show the date only)
settings.closeDateOnlyHint: Applications stay open until 23:59 on that day, and the page shows only the date.
settings.periodHint: Leave the opening time empty to open as soon as the link is saved; leave the closing time empty for no deadline.
settings.dateInvalid: Enter both the date and the time.
settings.closeAfterOpen: The closing time must be after the opening time.
settings.pagesLead: A closed page shows only a notice instead of its content (the menu stays).
settings.notePlaceholder: e.g. Work in progress. / Opens on Nov 1.
settings.noteHint: Shown while closed. Leave empty for the default: “{{text}}”

monitor.title: Monitoring control link
monitor.description: The link race-day referees and staff use to open monitoring control (live status, qualifying laps, ranking and seeds, finals results) without signing in. Anyone with the link can enter records, so share it only with people who need it.
monitor.onHint: The link below opens it without signing in.
monitor.offHint: Only signed-in staff can open monitoring control right now.
monitor.keyHint: 6–64 letters, digits, - or _. 'Generate' is recommended so it's hard to guess.
monitor.keyInvalid: Use only letters, digits, - and _, 6–64 characters.
monitor.keyRequired: Enter a secret value. To remove the link, press 'Turn off link'.
monitor.preview: Once saved, this link opens it.
monitor.replaceWarning: Saving blocks the current link right away. Send the new link to anyone who had the old one.
monitor.disableTitle: Turn off the monitoring control link?
monitor.disableBody: The current link stops working, and only signed-in staff can open monitoring control. You can create a new link later.
monitor.immediate: This applies as soon as it is saved, without publishing.

help: Applications and page visibility apply to the public site after you press 'Publish' above.
The monitoring control link applies as soon as it is saved.

users.title: Accounts
users.roleHint: Referees use monitoring control only; admins can change teams, schedule, rules, settings and accounts.
users.passwordRule: The password must be at least {{min}} characters.
users.created: Created {{role}} account {{name}}. Give the password to that person directly.
users.duplicate: '{{name}}' is already taken. Choose another username.

roleBody.admin: Admins can use every screen, including teams, schedule, rules, settings and accounts.
roleBody.referee: Referees can use only the dashboard and monitoring control (live status, qualifying laps, ranking and seeds, finals results).

users.selfDemote: If you make your own account a referee, you can no longer use this screen.
users.passwordBody: All sessions of this account end, and it must log in again with the new password.
users.passwordReset: Password reset. Give the new password to that person directly.
users.selfLogout: This is your own account, so you will be logged out right away.
users.deactivateBody: The account is logged out right away and cannot log in. You can reactivate it at any time.
help: Referees use the dashboard and monitoring control (live status, qualifying laps, ranking and seeds, finals results).
Turning off 'Active' signs the account out right away and blocks sign-in.

audit.title: Change history
audit.lead: Changes made in the admin pages and in monitoring control, newest first.

publish.label: Publish status
publish.pendingHint: Saved changes aren't on the public site yet. Check them in the preview, then press 'Publish'.
publish.cleanHint: Same as what the public site shows.
